for the petitioners.

Uttarakhand.

submits that due to the unfortunate demise 
of the learned chief standing counsel, a new 
learned chief standing counsel is required to 
be appointed. Hence, at the request of

adjourned by four weeks.

till the next date of listing.

Misc. application (IA No.10133 of 2020) 
is disposed off accordingly.
